encoding_rule: Descent is encoded by DRAWN LINE SHAPES (3990 Escher msosptLine objects), not by cell adjacency. A parent connects to its children via: a vertical stub from the parent cell's bottom edge, a horizontal bus in the blank spacer row below, and a vertical stub from the bus down to each child cell's top edge. Where a person has too many sons to fit horizontally, the chart instead uses a VERTICAL BRACKET: one long vertical bus running down the page with a short horizontal stub into each son's cell (attaching at the son's left/right edge, mid-height).
